summary: A planning claim rebuilds only its own planning session under the store writer, instead of every planning session the store has ever held.

replay.detail: Incremental projection of replicated planning-session claims, and the launch API's local planning writes, rebuild the planning tables of the sessions the claims name, from those sessions' claims in canonical order. A claim whose subject names no session still rebuilds the whole planning projection. Startup, the explicit projection rebuild and full graph replay keep the whole-projection rebuild. The projected rows are the same.

schema.detail: No schema, durable claim or projection table changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or graph digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version compatible with the previous release: no wire, claim or admission change, and a member on the previous release projects the same planning rows from the same claims (it rebuilds every session to get them). No coordinated upgrade.

downtime.detail: Activating the new binary uses the ordinary managed daemon replacement path.

manual.detail: No state repair, queue deletion or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes or new rollback restrictions. A rolled-back binary rebuilds every planning session for each planning claim again.
